0022600161.text: The Knicks, 2-4 and 11th in the East, host the winless Brooklyn Nets (0-5, 15th in the East) in their seventh game of the season, coming off a loss that leaves New York at 1-2 at home. Jose Alvarado is out for New York with an ankle sprain, while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Knicks won 4-0 in the 2025-26 season, including a 93-92 win in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
